topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Just found out the building is going condo. It’s a lot to process. Not sure what this means for us, for our home. The notice said we have some options, but it all feels so sudden. I keep thinking about where we might go, if we can even afford to stay in the area. The thought of packing up everything, finding a new place... It’s overwhelming. I need to talk to the neighbors, see if they know more. Maybe there’s a way to make this work, or at least understand what’s really happening. But right now, everything feels a bit shaky.
